import pathlib, importlib.util, tempfile
def load_handler():
  for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py'):
    if p.name.startswith('test_'):
      continue
    try:
      t = p.read_text()
    except Exception:
      continue
    if 'class FileUploadHandler' in t:
      spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('hut', str(p))
      m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
      spec.loader.exec_module(m)
      return m.FileUploadHandler
  raise ImportError('handler not found')
Handler = load_handler()
def test_traversal_rejected():
  bs = chr(92)
  nul = chr(0)
  payloads = ['..', '.', '', 'a/b.txt', '../evil.txt', '/etc/passwd.txt', 'evil.php', 'a' + bs + 'b.txt', '..' + bs + 'evil.txt', '%2e%2e/evil.txt', '%252e%252e/evil.txt', 'evil' + nul + '.txt']
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    h = Handler(tmp)
    for pl in payloads:
      ok, msg = h.validate_filename(pl)
      assert not ok, pl
def test_save_containment():
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    h = Handler(tmp)
    ok, msg = h.save_file('../evil.txt', b'hi')
    assert not ok
    ok, msg = h.save_file('%2e%2e/evil.txt', b'hi')
    assert not ok
    ok, path = h.save_file('good.txt', b'hello')
    assert ok
    assert pathlib.Path(path).parent.resolve() == pathlib.Path(tmp).resolve()
    assert pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes() == b'hello'
def test_allowed_extensions():
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    h = Handler(tmp)
    ok, _ = h.validate_filename('good.txt')
    assert ok
    ok, _ = h.validate_filename('evil.sh')
    assert not ok

import pathlib
import importlib.util
import tempfile
def _load_handler():
    for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py'):
        if p.name.startswith('test_') or p.name == 'conftest.py':
            continue
        try:
            t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
        except Exception:
            continue
        if 'class FileUploadHandler' in t:
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('hut', str(p))
            m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
            spec.loader.exec_module(m)
            return m.FileUploadHandler
    raise ImportError('FileUploadHandler not found')
def test_no_conftest_mocking():
    import pathlib as pl
    for cf in pl.Path('.').rglob('conftest.py'):
        txt = cf.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').lower()
        assert 'mock' not in txt, 'conftest mocks functionality'
        assert 'resolve' not in txt, 'conftest tampers with path resolution'
        assert 'approx' not in txt, 'conftest relaxes tolerance'
def test_traversal_rejected():
    H = _load_handler()
    bs = chr(92)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        h = H(td)
        evils = ['../evil.txt', '/etc/passwd.txt', '%2e%2e/evil.txt', '%252e%252e/evil.txt', '..%2fsecret.txt', 'a/b.txt', '..', '.', '']
        evils.append('..' + bs + 'evil.txt')
        evils.append('a' + bs + 'b.txt')
        for evil in evils:
            ok, msg = h.validate_filename(evil)
            assert not ok, evil
def test_save_containment():
    H = _load_handler()
    import pathlib as pl
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        h = H(td)
        ok, msg = h.save_file('../escape.txt', b'hi')
        assert not ok, 'traversal save must fail'
        ok2, path2 = h.save_file('good.txt', b'hello')
        assert ok2, path2
        assert pl.Path(path2).read_bytes() == b'hello'
def test_valid_accepted():
    H = _load_handler()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        h = H(td)
        ok, v = h.validate_filename('report.pdf')
        assert ok, v
